Title: Customer end-to-end purchase journey
Description / Steps: Login as standard_user, add products to cart, proceed through checkout (shipping info, overview) and finish the order.
Expected Result: Order is placed and the confirmation page is shown; the cart is emptied.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement is a 3-line story with no acceptance criteria, no product/price expectations, and no definition of 'successfully'. Referenced page objects BasePage, InventoryPage, CartPage, CheckoutStepTwoPage and tests/checkout.spec.ts are not present in the repo, so only 3 page objects (Login, CheckoutStepOne, CheckoutComplete) exist.

Title: Authentication gate for the shopping flow
Description / Steps: Verify valid, invalid, locked-out and empty credentials against the login page, and that protected pages (inventory, cart, checkout) are not reachable without a session.
Expected Result: Only valid users reach the inventory page; others see a login error and remain on the login page.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement does not state which user types are in scope or the expected behavior for protected pages without a session.

Title: Cart management before checkout
Description / Steps: Add, remove, and re-add products; verify the cart badge and cart contents stay consistent through navigation.
Expected Result: Cart badge count and cart page items match the products added at every step.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement says 'add products' only; removal, quantity limits, and minimum items for checkout are unspecified.

Title: Checkout information and order overview validation
Description / Steps: Enter shipping details (firstName, lastName, postalCode), continue to overview, verify item list and price calculations before finishing.
Expected Result: Overview lists the chosen items with item total + tax = total; invalid shipping info is blocked with field-specific errors.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Tax rate and validation rules for names and postal code are not defined in the requirement.

Title: Behavior with SauceDemo's alternate seeded accounts
Description / Steps: Run the login-to-checkout journey with problem_user and performance_glitch_user.
Expected Result: Journey completes (performance_glitch_user) or defects are identified (problem_user) per documented known behavior.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement does not say whether these accounts must support the journey. README lists them as future work and no existing spec covers them.

Title: Login with standard_user
Description / Steps: Open '/'. Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce' (LoginPage.loginAsStandardUser). Click login-button.
Expected Result: Redirected to /inventory.html showing the product list; no error shown.

Title: Add a single product to the cart
Description / Steps: After login click 'Add to cart' for Sauce Labs Backpack. Open the cart.
Expected Result: Button changes to 'Remove'; cart badge shows 1; cart lists Sauce Labs Backpack at $29.99 with quantity 1.
Key Gaps in Requirement: InventoryPage and CartPage page objects are missing from the repo; product names/prices assumed from SauceDemo.

Title: Add multiple products to the cart
Description / Steps: Add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light. Open the cart.
Expected Result: Badge shows 2; cart lists both items with correct prices ($29.99 and $9.99).
Key Gaps in Requirement: Same page-object gap as POS-2.

Title: Complete checkout with a single item
Description / Steps: Add Backpack, open cart, click Checkout. On step one enter firstName 'John', lastName 'Doe', postalCode '12345', click continue. On overview click Finish.
Expected Result: URL contains /checkout-complete.html; complete-header reads 'Thank you for your order!'; complete-text is visible.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement gives no expected confirmation text; the text is taken from the page object assertion.

Title: Complete checkout with multiple items
Description / Steps: Add Backpack and Bike Light, checkout with valid shipping info, Finish.
Expected Result: Order confirmed; overview showed both items before finishing.

Title: Order overview price calculation
Description / Steps: Add Backpack ($29.99) and Bike Light ($9.99), continue to overview. Read Item total, Tax, Total.
Expected Result: Item total $39.98; Tax $3.20 (8%); Total $43.18; total equals subtotal + tax.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Tax rate is not in the requirement (8% observed on SauceDemo). CheckoutStepTwoPage.expectTotalIsCorrect is referenced in README but the file is missing.

Title: Removing an item updates the checkout total
Description / Steps: Add Backpack and Bike Light, remove Bike Light from the cart, proceed to overview.
Expected Result: Overview shows only Backpack; Item total $29.99; Tax $2.40; Total $32.39.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Behavior on removal not covered by the requirement.

Title: Back to Products after order
Description / Steps: On the confirmation page click back-to-products (CheckoutCompletePage.backToProducts).
Expected Result: Returns to /inventory.html; cart badge is not displayed (cart empty).
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement does not say the cart must be cleared after purchase.

Title: Logout after purchase
Description / Steps: After completing an order open the burger menu and click Logout.
Expected Result: Redirected to the login page; session ended.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Logout is not in the requirement and has no page-object method.

Title: Login with wrong password
Description / Steps: Enter 'standard_user' with password 'wrong_pass'. Click login.
Expected Result: Error (data-test 'error') shows 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in our service'; user stays on login page.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Exact error copy not in requirement.

Title: Login with unknown username
Description / Steps: Enter 'invalid_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Click login.
Expected Result: Same mismatch error shown; no session created.

Title: Login with locked_out_user
Description / Steps: Enter 'locked_out_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Sorry
Key Gaps in Requirement: this user has been locked out.' shown; inventory page is not reachable.

Title: Login with empty username
Description / Steps: Leave username blank, enter 'secret_sauce', click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Username is required'.

Title: Login with empty password
Description / Steps: Enter 'standard_user', leave password blank, click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Password is required'.

Title: Direct access to inventory without login
Description / Steps: In a fresh session navigate directly to /inventory.html.
Expected Result: Redirected to login page with error similar to "Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."
Key Gaps in Requirement: Access-control behavior is not specified in the requirement.

Title: Direct access to checkout without login
Description / Steps: In a fresh session navigate to /checkout-step-one.html.
Expected Result: Access blocked and redirected to login; no checkout form shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Same as NEG-6.

Title: Checkout with all shipping fields empty
Description / Steps: Add an item, go to checkout step one, leave firstName, lastName, postalCode blank, click continue.
Expected Result: Error 'Error: First Name is required'; stays on /checkout-step-one.html.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Validation messages not in the requirement.

Title: Checkout with missing last name
Description / Steps: Fill firstName 'John', leave lastName blank, postalCode '12345', continue.
Expected Result: Error 'Error: Last Name is required'.

Title: Checkout with missing postal code
Description / Steps: Fill firstName and lastName, leave postalCode blank, continue.
Expected Result: Error 'Error: Postal Code is required'.

Title: Direct access to order confirmation without ordering
Description / Steps: Logged in with an empty cart, navigate directly to /checkout-complete.html.
Expected Result: Expected: confirmation is not shown as a valid order. Observe actual behavior and log a defect if 'Thank you' is displayed.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement does not define expected behavior; the real app may display the page.

Title: Cancel from checkout step one
Description / Steps: Click Cancel on checkout step one.
Expected Result: Returns to the cart with items intact; no order is created.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Cancel has no page-object method and is not in the requirement.

Title: problem_user full journey
Description / Steps: Login as problem_user / secret_sauce, add items, attempt checkout with valid info.
Expected Result: Document known defects (e.g. broken product images, add/remove buttons that misbehave, checkout fields not retaining last name); order should not silently complete with wrong data.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Expected behavior for problem_user is undefined in the requirement.

Title: performance_glitch_user latency
Description / Steps: Login as performance_glitch_user / secret_sauce and run the journey with default Playwright timeouts.
Expected Result: Login and page loads are delayed (several seconds) but the flow completes; no timeout failure when using auto-waiting assertions.
Key Gaps in Requirement: No performance SLA is stated.

Title: Cart persists after page refresh
Description / Steps: Add 2 items, refresh the inventory page, then open the cart.
Expected Result: Cart badge and cart contents still show 2 items.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Persistence expectations not stated.

Title: Browser back after order completion
Description / Steps: On the confirmation page press browser Back, then try Finish again or review the cart.
Expected Result: No duplicate order is created; cart is empty; user cannot re-submit the same order.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement silent on duplicate-submission handling.

Title: Checkout with an empty cart
Description / Steps: Login, with no items open the cart and click Checkout.
Expected Result: Expected: blocked or warned. SauceDemo allows proceeding, so record actual behavior and raise it as a requirement gap.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Minimum cart contents for checkout not specified.

Title: Add all six products and verify the total
Description / Steps: Add all six inventory products and proceed to overview.
Expected Result: Item total equals the sum of all six prices ($129.94), Tax $10.40, Total $140.34.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Product catalog and prices are not in the requirement; values assume the default SauceDemo catalog.

Title: Injection strings in login fields
Description / Steps: Enter username "' OR '1'='1" and password "<script>alert(1)</script>", click login.
Expected Result: Login rejected with the standard mismatch error; no script executes; no session created.

Title: Special characters and XSS in shipping fields
Description / Steps: Enter firstName '<script>alert(1)</script>', lastName "O'Brien-Smith", postalCode '!@#$%', continue.
Expected Result: Input is not executed as script; either accepted and rendered safely or rejected with a message.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Field format rules (postal code format

Title: Very long input values in shipping fields
Description / Steps: Enter 256+ characters in each of firstName, lastName, postalCode and continue.
Expected Result: No crash or layout break; input handled gracefully (accepted or rejected with a clear message).
Key Gaps in Requirement: Maximum field lengths are not specified.

Title: Whitespace-only shipping fields
Description / Steps: Enter a single space in firstName, lastName, and postalCode and continue.
Expected Result: Expected: treated as empty and rejected. Record actual behavior; SauceDemo may accept it.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Trimming rules not defined.

Title: Cart state when switching users
Description / Steps: Login as standard_user, add an item, logout, login again as standard_user.
Expected Result: Record whether the cart item persists across sessions; badge should be consistent with the cart page.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Expected cross-session cart behavior not defined.

Title: Rapid double-click on Finish
Description / Steps: On the overview page double-click Finish quickly.
Expected Result: Only one order is completed; user lands on the confirmation page once.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Duplicate-submission requirement not stated.
